basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from the Midwest, trying to balance my studies in graphic design with my love for gaming. I'm fairly new to the world of Reddit and still exploring various communities. My hobbies include playing Escape from Tarkov, watching esports, and dabbling in digital art. I usually hop online during the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time connecting with people who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a beginner's understanding of Escape from Tarkov, mostly self-taught through YouTube tutorials and trial-and-error gameplay. My knowledge in graphic design stems from my college courses and personal projects. I occasionally take part in online forums to improve my skills and understanding in both areas.
